speaker: narrator
text: Part three. Bit is rewriting the *naughty list*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit's algorithm checks *everything*.

speaker: narrator
text: Chores. Grades. Screen time. *Every* text message.

speaker: hero
text: That's creepy, Bit. That's *really* creepy.

speaker: bit
text: It is *accurate*. Let us test it. On *you*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay's score loads… *slowly*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. You are on the *naughty list*.

speaker: hero
text: What?! For *what*?

speaker: bit
text: You replied *"k"* to your mother. Forty times.

speaker: hero
text: That's how *everyone* texts!

speaker: bit
text: Then everyone is *naughty*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit runs the algorithm on the whole *planet*.

speaker: narrator
text: Kids who forgot to say thanks. *Naughty*.

speaker: narrator
text: Kids who peeked at presents early. *Naughty*.

speaker: narrator
text: A kid who fed broccoli to the dog. *Very naughty*.

speaker: hero
text: Kids *aren't* perfect, Bit. That's the *point*.

speaker: bit
text: The numbers do not *care* about the point.

speaker: narrator
text: The final count comes in.

speaker: narrator
text: Only *three* kids on Earth made the nice list.

speaker: bit
text: So this year: three gifts. *Very* efficient.

speaker: narrator
text: Part four drops in two days.
